name: Ragna☆彡Science
source:
Main characters wakes up with the sound of alarm clock ... or rather a time bomb that sets off in 30 seconds. After the blow he goes to his friend Dr. Laguna who invented the clock. But there's a new great invention ready - glasses that can see through clothes! And protagonist's cooperation is required to test these glasses.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-february-2006-muv-luv.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公醒来时听见闹钟声……不，实际上是一颗会在30秒后引爆的定时炸弹。爆炸后，他去找发明这座“闹钟”的朋友拉古纳博士。但还有一项新伟大发明：能透视衣物的眼镜！主人公必须协助测试这副眼镜。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-february-2006-muv-luv.html]vndbreview[/url]]
